title: Children's mental health paramount: Sikkim HC finds man guilty of driving girl to suicide by sexually assaulting her
description: The Sikkim High Court recently upheld the conviction of a 42-year-old man who was found guilty in 2023 of sexually assaulting a 16-year-old schoolgirl and abetting her suicide.A Division Bench of Chief Justice A Muhamed Mustaque and Justice Bhaskar Raj Pradhan said that the prosecution succeeded in proving that heinous acts of the convict Chewang Sherpa had led the victim to suicide in 2021."The evidence led by the prosecution is of conclusive nature and all reasonable hypothesis of innocence is
